Verify fresh heartbeat and exact task/attempt/continuation claim; do not create another task or runner.
For National LIDAR, query real tilename TQ3595/TQ5090/TQ2570 and record only returned survey/resolution/date fields.
For Time Stamped DTM, use ArcGIS exact point intersects with inSR=27700; OGC bbox may be used only with advertised EPSG:27700 bbox-crs support.
Obtain WCS GetCapabilities XML with an XML-capable client; record real CoverageId then DescribeCoverage before GetCoverage; never guess CoverageId.
Sample raw EA DTM1m pixels inside native HMLR EPSG:27700 polygons; exclude -3.4028235e+38 NoData and calculate stats only from observed pixels.
Call OS Downloads API productId Terrain50, area=TQ; require real JSON/archive bytes before accepting TQ39/TQ59/TQ27 members and per-tile metadata.
Run three EA/OS numeric crosschecks and port 8012 HTTP readback; promote only after evidence passes.
